claims: A watch covers a large area for several hours.
A warning is for a smaller area.
A warning indicates danger is happening now.
Conditions are favorable for severe weather (tornado, flash flood, thunderstorm) to develop under a watch.
A watch usually covers a large geographic area (multiple counties or states).
A severe weather event has been sighted or indicated by radar under a warning.
A warning usually covers a smaller, specific area (a few towns or counties).
A 1m YouTube video by 1m5NEWS published on Mar 4, 2026 explains the difference between a watch and a warning.
